selection.candidate: one per P patient, positive image for any patient with positive visit
selection.method: greedy farthest-first squared Euclidean, SHA256 order tie breaking
selection.features: DINO K4 flattened64 and RN128, each candidate block divided by sqrt(mean squared norm), equal weight

preprocessing: Original native P images; same pinned tensor/condition paths as P caches and existing PNGs, not resized/exported anew
